input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: The warranty package is otherwise strong: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and no malicious code; 19.4 gives re-performance, repair or replacement with termination and refund of Fees if Vendor cannot cure, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; and 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties while preserving express warranties, service levels, indemnities and stated remedies. The one gap against our preferred position is duration: Deliverables (which include configurations, integrations and other software work product under the definition in 1.4) carry only a ninety-day conformance period, whereas our preferred position is twelve months for software, with ninety days reserved for services. Hosted Services are already warranted for the whole subscription term, so the fix is confined to the Deliverable period. Minimal redline extends 19.2 to twelve (12) months, stated numerically; fallback is an express ninety (90) days with the 19.4 remedy untouched.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later,

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty in 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months, since Deliverables such as configurations and integrations are software work product and our position is a 12-month conformance period for software (90 days for services). If a shorter period is essential we can accept ninety (90) days, provided the numeral is stated expressly and the remedy in 19.4 is unchanged.
proposal.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformance warranty period in 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months.
